name: The Toby Project (Brooklyn feral coordinator)
neighborhoods: All 5 boroughs (free community-cat spay/neuter); Brooklyn TNR coordinator
notes:
Free spay/neuter + eartip for community cats in all five boroughs (surgery free; donations requested). Contact the Brooklyn coordinator for BK colony projects. Verify current schedule. Intake: Call or email to schedule mobile spay/neuter

FREE community-cat s/n, all 5 boroughs (Certified TNR Caretakers). Bklyn/Man/SI: (347) 816-2899. Bronx/Queens mobile: Tobyprojectnyc@gmail.com. $5 rabies only.

NYC's only org solely devoted to free/low-cost s/n; mobile vans + in-neighborhood clinics, works with DOHMH. Free s/n with proof of public assistance, reduced without; vaccines $8 (with s/n only). Email tobyprojectnyc@gmail.com (Bronx & Queens mobile scheduling) or (212) 315-5251; https://www.tobyproject.org/services.
